{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data structure and key columns
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print("Patients with multiple rows:")
print(duplicate_patients.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for unique values in key columns
print(f"\nUnique arms: {df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"\nUnique severity levels: {df['severity'].unique()}")
print(f"\nUnique assay batches: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"\nUnique responded values: {df['responded'].unique()}")"}
